SUSPECTED CARTEL TIES ➡️ ILLEGAL STATUS ➡️ ARRESTED 
 
Two suspected associates of a former Rio Bravo plaza boss were apprehended near Harlingen, TX, by USBP agents with help from our law enforcement partners. Both Mexican nationals were identified as being in the U.S. illegally and are now facing felony immigration charges. 
 
Individuals with ties to criminal cartel organizations have no place in this country. You will be targeted, arrested, prosecuted, and deported!   
@USBPChiefRGV

Disrupted Human Smuggling Scheme!
 
A U.S. citizen and a Mexican national were caught running a human smuggling operation out of an apartment in Laredo, TX, harboring two illegal aliens at the time of their arrest. The smugglers are facing alien smuggling charges, and the illegal aliens will be processed for deportation.
 
USBP is relentless in the fight against human smuggling—holding criminals accountable and protecting our communities.

tweets.text:
Checkpoint Bust 🛑
 
A K9 alert at the Javier Vega Jr. USBP immigration checkpoint in Kingsville, TX, led agents straight to 24 lbs. of cocaine—10 bundles hidden beneath the backseat. The driver is now in DEA custody, facing federal drug charges.
 
This isn’t just a “seizure”—it’s lethal doses that will never reach our neighborhoods, schools, or families.

tweets.text:
CHILD PREDATOR ARRESTED!
 
An illegal alien is now in USBP custody and facing deportation after previously being allowed back into our communities following a conviction for possession of child sexual abuse material.
 
In 2022, the Mexican national was convicted of possession of child sexual abuse material, serving just 180 days in jail and 2 years’ probation. In 2024, he violated his probation and served another 30 days. Under both circumstances, immigration detainers were ignored.
 
No matter the obstacles, we are devoted to keeping these dangerous predators off our streets.

GANGSTA ARRESTED IN HUMAN SMUGGLING SCHEME❗
 
A U.S. citizen with gang ties and an extensive criminal history tried to smuggle five illegal aliens through the Falfurrias USBP immigration checkpoint. After a K9 alert, agents found the illegal aliens hiding inside the sleeper area of the semi—all are pending deportation. The driver now faces federal charges for alien smuggling.
 
Transporting illegal aliens is a crime, and you will be prosecuted! PERIOD.

MASSIVE LOAD SEIZED: 782 LBS. OF COCAINE🚨
 
USBP technology detected a suspicious vessel sneaking through Puerto Rico’s waters under the cover of darkness. After a brief pursuit, law enforcement intercepted the boat and discovered 306 bricks of cocaine stashed in hidden compartments. One U.S. citizen is in HSI custody, pending prosecution.
 
USBP agents are relentless—no matter the hour, we’re stopping smugglers and protecting America’s shores.

@USBPChiefRMY

Never a dull moment! 
 
Agents in the Big Bend Sector encountered something you don’t see every shift: a zebra roaming the remote West Texas terrain. Agents worked alongside state and local partners to safely return the zebra to its home.
 
In the U.S. Border Patrol, no two days look the same—but the mission never changes.
